description: Defines the data model 'PopulatedNewsResource' for the external representation of a news resource, including relations to topics, and provides extension functions to convert this model into external and FTS entities.

classes.name: PopulatedNewsResource
classes.description: A data class representing a fully populated news resource with associated topics, as used in the external data layer.

methods.name: asExternalModel
methods.description: Converts a PopulatedNewsResource instance into an external NewsResource model.

methods.name: asFtsEntity
methods.description: Converts a PopulatedNewsResource instance into a full-text search entity for database indexing.
